title: The website editor previews a page in the fonts and accent the live site gives it
detail: Production hotfix, owner report 2026-10-13 (danieltyack.com/admin/editor): the canvas showed the site in the DAWN contract's Anton and amber while the live site wore the Bold font set (Sofia Sans Extra Condensed, Barlow) and the Space's teal. Root cause: the editor resolved its look on its own (websiteThemeVars(draft.theme, draft.brand?.accent)), ignoring the website font set (preferences.theme) and falling back to the contract accent instead of the Space brand accent and type default. Fix: lib/sites/site-render-style.ts (siteRenderStyle, siteCanvasVars) is the one resolver for theme, font set and accent; components/sites/site-page.tsx and components/sites/editor/shell.tsx both call it (the editor over sitePageStyle with its live style, so Theme tab picks and per-page themes repaint at once), and the canvas wears the result plus the font set's data-space-theme. SPACE_THEME_FONT_VARS (lib/theme/space-themes.ts) names each font set's faces, held to app/globals.css by the probe and lib/sites/site-render-style.test.ts. The live page no longer forces the Frequency font set when a Frequency site has a published editor snapshot (ADR-1726: the font set picks the faces); measured 2026-10-13, no Space had one, so no live page changed.
